Every item has a number and tags. They help to find and compare the items.

## What an Item Has

- **Number.** Items are numbered in the order of the issue, one-line entries included.
- **Date.** The day of the event.
- **Countries.** The countries in its title. The first is the actor's.
- **Actors.** The covered actors it is about.
- **Type.** The kind of action.

## Types

| Family | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Votes | Election | An election is held or its result comes, at any level. |
| | Referendum | Voters decide a question. |
| | Campaign | A campaign starts, an election authority decides who may run, or a vote is coming. |
| Office and Party | Office | A government is formed or falls. Someone takes or leaves office. |
| | Party | A party changes its leader, splits, merges or is founded. |
| Rules | Law | Parliament votes on a law or the constitution. |
| | Measure | A decree, an order, a rule or a spending decision of a government, also when only announced. |
| Justice | Court | A court rules, hears a case or receives one. |
| | Police and Prosecutors | An investigation, a search, a raid, an arrest or charges. |
| Abroad | Diplomacy | Visits, meetings, talks or mediation between states. An embassy opens or closes. |
| | Agreement | States sign, restore or leave an agreement, or join or leave an international body. |
| | Sanctions and Trade | Sanctions, tariffs or trade bans, imposed or lifted. |
| | Armed Forces | A strike, an operation, troops sent or withdrawn, or a measure the army carries out. |
| Street | Protest | A demonstration, a strike or a blockade. |
| Other | Other | Nothing else fits. |

## Rules

1. One item, one type.
2. The type is the kind of action, not its topic. The topic is in the item's link to the [Library](../library/index.qmd).
3. The title decides. Its first action gives the type. For a one-line entry, its first sentence does.

No tag says who was right or how much an event matters. The editor answers for every tag.

Every item with its tags stands in one dataset, which you can filter, chart and download. [Events in Monitor](../data/events.qmd)
